name: EMA 9 crosses the session VWAP, 5m, 05:00-09:00 ET, held to 15:55
why: Founder's TradingView script: VWAP x EMA 9 cross, each cross reverses. Pre-registered 2026-10-28 (research/preregistered/2026-10-28_new_families.md).

scan.when: !rollwin && ((ema(5,9) > vwap && lag(5, ema(5,9) <= vwap)) || (ema(5,9) < vwap && lag(5, ema(5,9) >= vwap)))
scan.dir: (ema(5,9) > vwap && lag(5, ema(5,9) <= vwap)) - (ema(5,9) < vwap && lag(5, ema(5,9) >= vwap))
